    The total space of grRep #

    The cover object of a pair (y, g) is cov y g = (y, g ≫ ℓ y); every cover object is cov a.y (gOf a) (cov_gOf). The projection of M onto W a is e_{a.y} ∘ proj_{g(a)} (projW). If S contains every cover object with W a ≠ 0, summing the components identifies the total space of grRep S with M (totEquiv).
